fact.en: Confusing the Battle of Hydaspes with the Battle of Gaugamela; Hydaspes was fought against Porus, not Darius III.

fact.en: Assuming Alexander conquered the entire Magadhan Empire; he stopped at the Hyphasis (Beas) river due to mutiny.
